scope: offline content-addressed normalization of the ten GVHMR body-shape estimates; no GMR rerun, height calibration, A3 acceptance, training, or real-robot work

aggregation.reason: first reduce within each video, then give every video one equal vote so the 35-98 frame clip-length spread cannot weight the body-shape estimate
aggregation.same_performer_assertion_basis: direct 2026-07-11 user statement that the three Franco/v6/v7 sets were just recorded by the user
aggregation.identity_scope: this ten-video intake only; not a biometric identity claim
aggregation.source_shape_policy: accept only (10,), (1,10), or (frames,10), preserve each source shape, and repeat the canonical vector over every row because the current GMR loader consumes row zero
aggregation.storage_policy: all ten sources must share one tensor/array storage kind and one dtype; quantize the cohort median once to that dtype
aggregation.all_other_fields: bit-exact semantic digest before and after torch save/reload

gmr_loader_observation.semantics: load_gvhmr_pred_file reads smpl_params_global.betas[0], pads six zeros to the ten beta components, passes the resulting 16-vector to neutral SMPL-X, and derives actual_human_height as 1.66 + 0.1 * beta[0]
gmr_loader_observation.consequence: every materialized row must equal the canonical vector; the derived height is an upstream heuristic and is not measured height or A3 calibration
gmr_loader_observation.current_repo_queue_compatibility: incompatible: scripts/run_motion_video_gmr_queue.py hard-codes diagnostic_video_betas in output names, bindings and audits, so pointing it at these materialized PTs would create a false lineage label

formal_blockers: no measured performer height is bound; GMR's beta-zero height heuristic is not a calibration
the same-performer assertion is an intake provenance statement, not biometric or multi-camera body-shape truth
the exact on-Pod GMR loader source SHA is not yet bound to this preregistration
the existing GMR queue hard-codes diagnostic_video_betas and cannot safely label canonical-betas reruns
canonical-betas GMR reruns and their warm-up/finite/grounding/collision audits have not run
mirror, rally yaw, grip rotation, strike phase, contact truth, table/net clearance, returnability and transition-to-ready are unverified
schema-2 conversion, TOPP, RL training and all real-robot gates have not run
